title: Reading Drill — Surveying mail delivery on foot — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Surveying mail delivery on foot — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The postal route planner in Elmbrook received an old report about deliveries taking longer along roads with large front yards. The report compared average time at each address, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the route diaries rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered four weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include the number of parcels. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed grouped mailboxes by the pavement as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
